title: Let peace reach the mouth and the walk
summary: This meets devotional effort that still feels theatrical and restless. The line says peace grows in saintly company until speech sweetens and the walk humbles.
takeaway: Let remembrance shape speech and conduct.
lifeApplication: Before speaking in a tense room, lower the chin and slow the pace. Let the body and mouth match the peace you say you want.

source.shortMeaning: Holy company and Naam make speech sweet and the walk humble.
source.lifeApplication: Before you answer, let your pace and tone come under remembrance.

evidence.coreClaim: Holy company and Naam make speech sweet and the walk humble.
evidence.turn: When remembrance is real, it reaches the mouth and the walk.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before speaking in a tense room, lower the chin and slow the pace. Let the body and mouth match the peace you say you want.
